Subject: Choice of SCCs modules & evidence for EU→UK transfer

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving toward contract execution and need to confirm the appropriate SCCs modules for our EU controller → Redwood (processor) flows when data is routed to the UK. Legal here prefers an approach that preserves narrow processing scope and minimizes downstream subprocessor complexity. A few asks from our side to finish internal approvals: 

- Which SCCs module combination do you recommend for EU controller → Redwood (processor) with occasional UK routing? Is Module 2 (Controller to Processor) alone sufficient, or do we need to bind a Module 5-style clause or UK addendum?
- Can you provide the redlined SCCs doc (we prefer DocuSign for signature routing) and a short checklist of available evidence (SOC 2, DPIA summary, security questionnaire responses)?
- Do you support signing the EU SCCs + UK Addendum (or equivalent IDTA) in a single envelope? If so, please send the link.

If easier, Monica from your team can coordinate the legal ops side. Our internal target: get signatures + SOC2 evidence submitted to procurement by end of next week (timeline is flexible but they'd like a clear package).

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Sr. Counsel, Data & Privacy
GreenHealth Ltd

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Choice of SCCs modules & evidence for EU→UK transfer

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then details below: 

1) Recommendation: Module 2 (Controller → Processor) is the correct primary module for the EU→Redwood relationship. Because GreenHealth has occasional routing to the UK, we recommend: 
   - Primary: EU SCCs Module 2 (Controller → Processor)
   - Supplement: UK Addendum (IDTA) to cover UK jurisdictional transfer requirements. 

Why: Module 2 covers the legal relationship between controller and processor. The UK Addendum ensures continuity for transfers when personal data moves to UK-based infra or subprocessors. Combining them in a single signing flow is standard practice and supported on our side.

2) Evidence pack: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II, a short DPIA summary, and our completed SIG/CAIQ snapshot. Ben will attach the SOC2 redaction and Monica will drop the DPIA summary into Drive.

3) DocuSign: yes — we can send a single envelope that contains the EU SCCs redline + UK Addendum as separate exhibits. Please confirm the signer list and whether GreenHealth wants signatory names (procurement / legal) or an internal signer pool link.

Next steps (proposed):
- Ben (legal ops) prepares the SCCs redline with our standard Module 2 + UK Addendum language.
- Monica shares the evidence bundle (SOC 2 redacted, DPIA summary) to your Drive link.
- Send DocuSign envelope (Monica / Ben to coordinate).

I’ll leave Ben and Monica to follow up with the attachments and envelope. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk the package through.

Thanks,
Priyom
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
